sources.snippet: To address this, we introduce QA-ViT, a Question Aware Vision Transformer approach for multimodal reasoning, which embeds question awareness directly within the vision encoder. sources.title: Question Aware Vision Transformer
sources.snippet: The paper introduces QA-ViT, a model-agnostic technique that integrates question awareness into the vision encoder for improved multimodal reasoning. It dynamically aligns visual features with textual queries using a gating mechanism in self-attention layers, leading to consistent performance boosts on VQA and scene-text tasks.
